theme: Neo-Brutalist Premium mixed with Soft Utility

typography.strategy: Load custom fonts via expo-font with local assets (.ttf/.otf) in /assets/fonts. DO NOT use @expo-google-fonts packages.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro & Earthy Mix (Trust + Action)

primary.description: Vibrant Orange for primary CTAs (resonates with Mobile Money in CI).

secondary.description: Deep Slate/Navy for Trust and Premium feel.

spacing_and_layout.safe_area: Use react-native-safe-area-context for all top/bottom paddings to avoid notches.

button.primary: Height 56, bg #FF6B00, radius 16, justify center, align items center. Text: body_large, white, bold.

card_shop.container: bg #FFFFFF, radius 16, shadow sm, padding 16. Flex row for horizontal list, column for grid.
card_shop.logo_wrapper: bg #F8FAFC, radius 12, align items center, justify center, aspect ratio 1.

input.style: Height 56, bg #F8FAFC, borderWidth 1, borderColor #E2E8F0, radius 12, paddingHorizontal 16, fontSize 16.

OTP_Login.layout: Column. Top: Logo and welcoming header ('Bienvenue'). Middle: Phone number input with +225 country code prefixed, Send OTP button. Bottom: 'Continuer sans compte' (optional).
OTP_Login.details: Mock auth. Use standard keyboard. Primary CTA sticking to the keyboard.

Home_Countries.header: Sticky header with User profile icon, Location (Abidjan, CI), Cart icon.
Home_Countries.hero: Banner: 'Achetez partout, livré à Abidjan' (bg #0F172A, text white).
Home_Countries.filters: Horizontal ScrollView of Country Chips (France, USA, Chine).
Home_Countries.shop_grid: 2-column grid of Shop Cards (Shein, Amazon, Zara, H&M, etc.).

Shop_Detail_Calculator.header: Solid or Blurred header over shop banner (safe area padded), Back button.
Shop_Detail_Calculator.layout: ScrollView. Shop logo & Description. 'How it works' brief. 'Visiter la boutique' external link button.
Shop_Detail_Calculator.calculator_card: Sticky or inline card: Input price in original currency (EUR/USD/CNY). Auto-calculates XOF including import fee + local delivery. Clear breakdown row by row.
Shop_Detail_Calculator.add_to_cart: Form to paste external product URL, select size/qty, and save to cart.

Cart.layout: List of saved products. Each item: Thumbnail, Name, URL, Original Price, Converted Price (XOF).
Cart.bottom_summary: Fixed bottom view (paddingBottom: safeArea): Subtotal, Shipping, Total (XOF). 'Passer à la caisse' primary button.

Checkout_Mobile_Money.layout: Stepper: 1. Address in CI, 2. Payment Method.
Checkout_Mobile_Money.payment_methods: Grid of mock buttons for Orange Money, MTN, Moov, Wave. Selecting one expands to show phone input & 'Payer' CTA.

Orders_Tracking.tracking_card: Shows Order ID, Shop. Stepper component for status: Achat en cours -> Expédié -> En transit -> Arrivé à Abidjan -> Livreur en route -> Livré.
Orders_Tracking.courier_call_action: If status is 'Livreur en route', highlight a prominent 'Appeler le livreur' button with a phone icon.

motion.interactions: All touchables MUST use TouchableOpacity or Pressable with opacity reduction on press.
motion.modals: Use standard React Native Modal or custom bottom sheets for Calculator and Payment flows to keep context.

accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include testID / data-testid attributes to facilitate robust automated testing. E.g., testID='login-submit-button'.
accessibility.screen_reader: Add accessibilityLabel to icon-only buttons (e.g., Back button, Cart).

image_urls.description: Woman holding shopping bags, representing global fashion/shopping. Use in Home hero or auth background.
Delivery person holding package. Use in tracking screen when package is ready or delivered.
Cargo containers. Use for 'En transit' state or import explanation banners.

media.icons: Use lucide-react-native for all icons (ShoppingCart, User, MapPin, Phone, ArrowRight, ChevronDown, Package). StrokeWidth 2.

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: React Native with Expo. Share guidelines for .js files.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use standard React Native StyleSheet objects. Avoid HTML/CSS syntax.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: DO NOT use @expo-google-fonts. Assume local font files in assets/fonts and use expo-font 'useFonts' hook.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_rules: Always wrap main screens in SafeAreaView or use react-native-safe-area-context. No completely transparent headers over scrolling content.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive mobile UI that surprises and delights.
Create depth through layered design elements with subtle shadows (elevation in RN).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Padding 16px is minimum for screen edges.
Every interaction needs feedback - press states, loading spinners on buttons.
Main agent relies on image URLs provided. Do not use placeholder URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` (and `data-testid`) attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts for everything. Left-align text for better readability.
